ticket.title: Bulk action to mark selected invoices as paid in the invoice list
ticket.description: Accountants currently mark invoices as paid one by one after each bank import, which is slow. The reporter requests a bulk Mark as paid action for invoices selected in the invoice list.

feature.userNeed: Accountants mark invoices as paid one by one after every bank import, and it takes a long time.
feature.proposedBehavior: In the invoice list, the user selects several invoices using the checkboxes. As soon as at least one is selected, a button called Mark as paid appears. Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog that shows how many invoices will be changed. The paid date is set to today by default. Invoices that are already paid are skipped and not changed.
acceptanceCriteria: The invoice list has checkboxes that allow selecting several invoices.

Clicking Mark as paid opens a confirmation dialog that shows how many invoices will be changed.
The paid date is set to today by default.
Invoices that are already paid are skipped and not changed.
